purpose: Before any new training, screen every materially-distinct EXISTING teacher on the scientifically central held-out domains to see whether an already-produced model solves the oxygen-deficient force-fidelity gap.

screening_set.description: exact seed-123 held-out TEST frames restricted to the three central domains
screening_set.provenance: dataset_index taken verbatim from the committed exact-heldout per-frame metrics (fresh_test_per_frame_metrics.csv); identical structures evaluated for every candidate
screening_set.metric_defs: component force MAE/RMSE over atoms x 3; normalized_RMSE = err_RMSE / DFT_component_RMS; energy_MAE per atom (meV) reported with convention caveat

base_b56e20ff.identity: = 03_allegro_train compiled output (byte-identical); the current pipeline teacher
base_b56e20ff.screened: reused (NOT rerun) from committed exact-heldout per-frame metrics
base_b56e20ff.dedup_note: the .pt2 (6c172722) and best.ckpt (51342b33) are the SAME base model in other formats -> not distinct candidates

teacher_finetuned_v2_b3be4d2a.identity: ER (elastic-response/energy-anchored) fine-tune of the base teacher
teacher_finetuned_v2_b3be4d2a.screened: fresh NequIPCalculator inference on the SAME 373 frames (19.7 min, CPU)

teacher_v6_finetuned_277262dc.identity: tier-weighted ER-FT teacher, warm-started from a T1 checkpoint (2026-07-08, NOT from base b56e20ff), trained on 16 DFT-anchor defect cells to lower the defect-core force floor
teacher_v6_finetuned_277262dc.source: v6_return_package/ (transferred 2026-08-10; teacher/ + validation/ only — ER-FT training data NOT local)
teacher_v6_finetuned_277262dc.in_sample_certification: Stage1 STAGE1_v6_SUMMARY.md certifies err(a)_core = 0.360 eV/A on the 17 anchor cells, but those are ALL in-sample; the summary itself flags held-out generalization was never tested
teacher_v6_finetuned_277262dc.screened: fresh NequIPCalculator inference on the SAME 373 frames (19.7 min, CPU)
teacher_v6_finetuned_277262dc.leakage_caveat: v6 ER-FT set has 136 'base' frames of unknown split-origin; a null/worse held-out result is robust to leakage (leakage would only help). Overlap check would be required ONLY if v6 had improved.

advancement_rule: A candidate advances only if it CLEARLY improves dilute and/or clustered oxygen-deficient fidelity WITHOUT degrading amorphous. No invented pass/fail accuracy threshold; the rule is a monotone-improvement comparison against the base.
decision_rationale: Both fine-tuned candidates are WORSE than base in every central domain (force MAE up everywhere). teacher_finetuned_v2 marginally worse; teacher_v6_finetuned worse by more (clustered +0.0109) DESPITE its in-sample err(a)_core certification — its anchor-cell improvement does NOT generalize to held-out defect structures. No existing teacher improves oxygen-deficient fidelity.
consistency_with_root_cause: Consistent with the established PC001 finding A_MODEL_TRAINING_UNDERFIT: ER fine-tuning (v2 energy-anchored; v6 defect-core-anchored) re-anchors targeted quantities but does not lower the force-fitting floor on held-out defect domains (train error ~= test error there). v6 in particular shows in-sample anchor-cell gains that do not transfer out-of-sample. Only a new controlled training experiment can test whether the floor is movable.
